title: Minimizing the Expected Cost of Synchronization in Lossless Power Networks
summary: The reliable operation of large-scale electric power networks is increasingly challenging, particularly with the integration of stochastic renewable generation. In this work, we address the problem of minimizing network transients by optimally modifying the underlying network. We formulate the problem in terms of graph Laplacian matrices and show that, under certain assumptions, the problem is convex.
